summary: Independent final review approves ML-001 at dcc28da2bbd2c5f7a6530af982de5f2328733a44 with no blocking findings. The implementation checkpoint abf685e391550dc7b8c51f4c833a1cbb14916c03 contains a deterministic, standard-library-only synthetic pipeline, fictional identifiers, documented seed and data dictionary, patient-separated split, leakage assertions, retained-output runnable notebook, actual held-out baseline/model metrics and confusion matrix, explicit limitations, and model-generated T-7/T-2/T-1 exports. Canonical, bundled, and public result JSON are byte-identical at SHA-256 f13482c5c4b530257250ca7469102d901bd113ca1993a822ee457239c4fb8d21; recomputation and tests bind checkpoint scores 13.8/20.5/26.4, factors and feature values to the fitted model without identity or future-workflow features. The staff Case Workspace Insights tab presents those saved outputs, accessible checkpoint-specific Why flagged? disclosures, separately attributed workflow suggestions, evidence links, synthetic metrics and limitations, plus the same-model transportation-only sensitivity 45.2 to 26.4 (-18.8) without runtime inference, arbitrary inputs, causal or calibrated-risk claims, or workflow mutation. Typed validation fails closed for tampered, malformed, incomplete, missing-factor and missing-comparison data while leaving the staff workflow available; FLOW-001 remains authoritative, and the explicit prepared patient concern independently opens human-owned clinical and transportation work. Comparison/disclosure state is component-local and resets on exit, with keyboard-operable tabs, disclosures and controls. Approved design evidence and inspected desktop/mobile captures show a native extension of the locked Clinical Glass system without token or global-pattern drift. The user-owned landing-loop commit e0214c3ddb0c53b159ea2208cfb31072b81e284a remains an ancestor, and its LandingPage.tsx/index.css changes are unchanged after that commit. Verification PASSED at abf685e; the later 61ab5c2 and dcc28da commits contain only verification evidence and the REVIEW status transition, so the evidence is current under repository freshness rules. Reviewer reruns passed the 4-test ML suite, 6-test focused Insights suite and 5-test FLOW split/override suite. SMOKE depth and LOW risk correctly require neither an independent tester nor dedicated security review. ML-001 is ready to remain in REVIEW while the shared sprint continues and for eventual human-authorized merge; subsequent sprint changes must refresh affected commit-bound evidence before final merge.
